independence_evidence: About page describes it as an independent magazine; publisher is the founder-editor personally, based at a Brussels address, distributed by Idea Books and Antenne Books.
qualifies_reason: Independent Brussels queer-feminist magazine whose Issue 15 (cover dated 2026) is on sale on its own site and at Antenne Books since October 2026.
what_it_is: A queer-feminist magazine from Brussels devoted to women and trans people working in art, culture and activism, with each issue built around a theme such as Economy, Biography, The Club Scene or Letters of Disappointment. Issues combine essays, personal writing, conversations and artists' visual contributions; the latest one is a collective publication made with a closing lesbian and trans bar. It is for readers of feminist and queer theory, art writing and small-press culture.
